mapper.insert: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS soft_deleted_blobs ( record_id INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY, blob_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, source_blob_store_name VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, deleted_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, date_path_ref TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, CONSTRAINT pk_soft_deleted_blobs_record_id PRIMARY KEY (record_id) );
INSERT INTO soft_deleted_blobs (blob_id, source_blob_store_name, date_path_ref) VALUES (#{blobId}, #{sourceBlobStoreName}, #{datePathRef});
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM soft_deleted_blobs WHERE source_blob_store_name = #{sourceBlobStoreName} AND blob_id = #{blobId};
